summary: ACM Research, Inc. filed an 8-K to furnish a record of investor relations activity by its subsidiary ACM Research (Shanghai), Inc., which is listed on the STAR Market. The record summarizes a conference call with analysts, including company introduction and Q&A on business outlook and order distribution. No special-situation transaction, such as merger, tender offer, or strategic review, is disclosed. This is a routine investor relations disclosure, not a special situation.
